about: License texts traced to the exact source of a runtime package that ships none (tools/runtime_notices.py). Each entry is used only for that name, version and lock integrity, with its text checked against textSha256.

packages.name: standardwebhooks
evidence: The package ships no license text: its tarball holds README.md, dist/ and package.json, which declares MIT.

Its npm SLSA provenance (https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/standardwebhooks@1.1.1) names this tarball (sha512 equal to the integrity above), built from this commit by .github/workflows/javascript-release.yml, which publishes from libraries/javascript.
At this commit libraries/javascript has no license file. libraries/LICENSE, the nearest license file above it, is MIT (unchanged since c7cd8a9e, 2023-09-21) and matches the declared license.
The repository's root LICENSE at this commit is the Apache License 2.0 text (blob 261eeb9e); it does not match the declared license and is not used.
